steps.title: Welcome to OreX
steps.description: Welcome to OreX! This quick tour will show you around the dashboard, the market, and how to make your first trade.

steps.title: Your Balance
steps.description: This is your current cash balance. You start with a set amount of cash to invest in ores.

steps.title: Net Worth
steps.description: Your net worth combines your cash balance and the current market value of everything you hold.

steps.title: The Market
steps.description: Head to the Market page to see every ore available to trade and how its price is moving.

steps.title: Browse Ores
steps.description: Each row is an ore you can trade. Click on one to see its detailed price chart.

steps.title: Price Chart
steps.description: This chart shows how the ore's price has moved over time, helping you decide when to buy or sell.

steps.title: Buy or Sell
steps.description: Use the Buy and Sell buttons here to trade this ore at the current market price.

steps.title: Your Portfolio
steps.description: Everything you buy shows up in your Portfolio, where you can track quantity, value, and profit.

steps.title: Holdings Overview
steps.description: Here you can see every ore you own, how much you paid, and its current value.

steps.title: Leaderboard
steps.description: Compare your net worth against other players on the leaderboard. Climb the ranks by trading smart!

steps.title: Welcome to Advanced Mode
steps.description: You've unlocked Advanced Mode! This tour covers the new tools available to you: shorting, stop-loss/take-profit, and more.

steps.title: Finances Page
steps.description: The Finances page breaks down your capital: cash, collateral in use, and equity tied up in open positions.

steps.title: Capital Breakdown
steps.description: This shows exactly how your capital is allocated across cash, long holdings, and short collateral.

steps.title: Opening a Short
steps.description: Think an ore's price will fall? Open a short position here to profit from the decline.

steps.title: Collateral & Fees
steps.description: Shorting requires collateral and accrues an hourly fee. Keep an eye on both to avoid liquidation.

steps.title: Stop-Loss / Take-Profit
steps.description: Set automatic stop-loss and take-profit levels so your positions close themselves at the price you choose.

steps.title: Resistance & Support
steps.description: Advanced Mode overlays resistance and support levels on the chart to help you spot likely turning points.

steps.title: Cash Runway
steps.description: This indicator warns you when your available cash is running low relative to your open risk.
